<Heading as={"h1"} className={"openapi__heading"}>
  {"Delete runtime backup"} <MarkerAddedInVersion version="8.10" />{" "}
  <MarkerScope scope="physical-tenant" />
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/backups/runtime/{backupId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

<MarkerStronglyConsistentExtension />

Deletes the runtime backup with the given id.

<MarkerRequiredPermissions
  permissions={[{ resourceType: "BACKUP", permissionType: "DELETE" }]}
/>

<Heading id={"request"} as={"h2"} className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[
    {
      name: "backupId",
      in: "path",
      required: true,
      description: "The id of the backup.",
      schema: {
        title: "Backup ID",
        description:
          "The id of the backup. Must be a positive numerical value. As backups are logically\nordered by their ids (ascending), each successive backup must use a higher id than the\nprevious one.\n",
        type: "integer",
        format: "int64",
        example: 1,
        minimum: 1,
      },
    },
  ]}
></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema title={"Body"} body={undefined}></RequestSchema>
